messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High auth failure spike and anomalous fanout detected from multiple proxy ASNs. /v1/auth 5xxs +11%, failed logins ~8.7k/min. Root TS: 1719876543
oncall-eng: Paged. I’m looking at ingress and auth service KPIs. Any immediate user-facing errors?
Leo: No 5xx spread to customers yet but auth failures are concentrated from 3 ASN clusters. Token churn is abnormal. Looks like credential stuffing + session reuse via proxies.
Maya: Recommend immediate edge-level per-IP throttling + short quota-slice per token fingerprint. Also suggestion: suspend anonymous embeddings and async batch ingestion briefly.
Jamie (sre): Applying edge rule: `edgectl apply --rule='auth-abuse-50' --path '/v1/auth' --limit=15r/m/ip --scope=global` now. Will roll in 20s.
SecOps: Prep WAF denylist for the proxy ASNs and create an IPset. Also enabling challenge/captcha on suspicious auth flows.
oncall-eng: Edge rule active. Initial drop ~40% of offending traffic. Still seeing tail from churned tokens.
Ivy (product): If we suspend anon embeds, support should craft a short status note. Also check impact on trial customers.
Oliver (support): Draft: "We have applied protective rate limits and temporary feature restrictions to mitigate abusive traffic. If you are impacted, contact support." Ready to post after security review.
Leo: Adding a temporary limit on new session creation: `service.auth.max_new_sessions_per_min=4` for public tiers.
Maya: Toggling feature flag: `ff:disable anon_embeddings --ttl=15m`.
Jamie (sre): Feature flag updated. WAF + edge throttles + quota change are live. Metrics show auth failures declining.
SecOps: Kicking off log ingestion for fingerprints and geo correlations. We'll escalate to ISP takedown requests if persistent.
oncall-eng: Any enterprise customers in those ASNs? Need to avoid collateral blocks.
Leo: Quick cross-check: two enterprise customer IPs overlap ASN but traffic patterns are normal. Excluding them from denylist now.
Ivy (product): Support, add those customers to DM list and add a contact for expedited whitelisting.
Oliver (support): Done. Status page draft updated; DM prepared.
Nate (oncall): Taking the handoff in 10m. Current mitigations: edge rate-limit, ASN denylist, session quota-slice, anon-embeddings disabled, captcha on suspicious flows. Health: error rate trending down, auth latencies stable.
Maya: Rollback plan: 1) Re-enable anon embeddings after 30m stable 2) Relax edge limit to 40r/m/ip 3) Remove ASN denylist except persistent offenders.
Jamie (sre): Snapshotting mitigation config and metrics to incident log: `incidents/1719876543/mitigation-snapshot.json`.
SecOps: Beginning deeper forensics. If we confirm a botnet, we'll prepare legal packet and ISP contacts.
Nate (oncall): I'll monitor dashboards and alert on any regression. Will update in 30m or sooner. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
